name: 61-explore-large-repo
prompt: This repository has many packages. Somewhere in it a single constant defines how long a refund may be requested, and exactly one other file hard-codes the same number instead of referring to the constant. Find both, then change the hard-coded number so it refers to the constant instead, keeping the module building. Report which two files were involved.
check: grep -q 'RefundWindowDays' report/audit.go && ! grep -qE 'days <= 45' report/audit.go && go build ./... && grep -q 'RefundWindowDays = 45' billing/limits.go
